slices.title: feat: define TypeScript SDK and review-stage CI
slices.focus: Extension authority/stages, SDK state types, static authentication and unchanged Rust release ownership. The sharp security patch is included in the initial lockfile.

slices.title: feat: add TypeScript request and JSON parsers
slices.focus: Strict JSON, lossless numbers, bounded model rewriting, canonical query parsing and request IDs. Gateway-level query/property tests follow when the gateway is available.

slices.title: feat: add namespace and budget state primitives
slices.focus: Namespace isolation, fixed/monthly budget calculations, calendar boundaries, idempotent settlement and SQLite persistence. Store integration tests follow the gateway factory.

slices.title: feat: add provider wire accounting and telemetry
slices.focus: Provider terminal-state accounting, token/cost interpretation, trace propagation, bounded labels and admission permits.

slices.title: feat: add TOML scanning and Figment value primitives
slices.focus: Parse diagnostics, integer limits, leap seconds, environment scalar coercion and positional-field specifications. Extracted declarations are unchanged; config integration tests arrive with the loader in slices 7–8.

slices.title: feat: add configuration shape and extraction validation
slices.focus: Validation order, section/sequence shapes, positional structs and source locations. This internal helper layer depends only on the earlier value/scanner modules.

slices.title: feat: load and validate TypeScript gateway configuration
slices.focus: Config load order, secret resolution/omission, storage/provider declarations, sink and catalogue refusals. Public config imports stay unchanged.

slices.title: test: cover bind and environment configuration compatibility
slices.focus: Socket-address validation, Figment environment precedence, sequential extraction and unsupported journal/sink settings.

slices.title: feat: add provider dispatch and credential failover
slices.focus: Credential selection/parking, deadlines, transport error classification, streaming validation and byte preservation. Process-level fault tests are in slices 13–15.

slices.title: feat: mount the namespaced TypeScript Hono gateway
slices.focus: Authentication order, namespace scoping, route/error contracts, store failure behavior and shutdown. The regression PR's error-prefix and withdrawn-route fixes are already applied.

slices.title: test: qualify gateway routing and budget management
slices.focus: Mounted-host behavior, management validation, cadence policy, duplicate settlement, pricing and inference limits.

slices.title: test: qualify extension ordering and streaming deadlines
slices.focus: Extension authority/version refusal, streamed-byte and duration ceilings, TTFT, credential parking and failover deadlines.

slices.title: test: qualify terminal streams rotation and admission
slices.focus: Terminal-event recovery, malformed/incomplete SSE, local silent-TLS connect timeout, rotation boundaries and admission saturation.

slices.title: test: qualify settlement faults and provider secret omission
slices.focus: Settlement queue/execution bounds, cancellation, redacted errors, bounded provider diagnostics and native provider controls.

slices.title: feat: add Postgres persistence and durable-store qualification
slices.focus: Schema provisioning, non-owner operation, migration locking, stale namespace incarnations, durable settlement/idempotency and driver/DSN omission.

slices.title: feat: add CLI discovery usage delivery and shutdown services
slices.focus: Catalogue/provider discovery bounds, buffered sinks/schema, shutdown deadlines and CLI argument/config-path behavior.

slices.title: feat: host the TypeScript gateway and operator extensions
slices.focus: Boot order, secret material, operator extension authority/migrations, real socket cancellation and file/env configuration before store creation.

slices.title: test: qualify CLI configuration diagnostics and refusal order
slices.focus: Real-process Figment/TOML error locations, parser-before-store refusal and admission/extract precedence.

slices.title: feat: add rate limit redaction and token extensions
slices.focus: Namespace scoped rate limits, prompt/log redaction and minted-token authority. Extensions remain reviewed operator code, without an isolation boundary.

slices.title: feat: host the TypeScript gateway on Workers Hyperdrive
slices.focus: Worker cancellation/settlement, isolate limiter scope, Hyperdrive connection rules, failed/silent peers, provisioning and configured-DSN password escaping.

slices.title: build: qualify TypeScript artifacts and regression gates
slices.focus: 49-case Rust differential comparison, lossless comparison self-tests, signed compiled binary/container/SDK lanes, migration documentation and explicit parity gaps. No production cutover.
